==Background==
{{Quote|There is no "If you do do."|Author's comment}}
"'''Ifuudoudou'''" is an original song by Umetora and is his most notable song. It was uploaded to YouTube on March 30, 2016.

This song is about a group of 5 girls and their sexual encounters, with Luka being the leader.

This song is in the ''[[Hall of Legend]]''.
